findings.summary: Luna incorrectly classified three current frozen wine items as missing. The official Wine List currently contains Moët & Chandon, Monemvasia Winery Tsimbidi Anthosmias, and Ruinart Rosé; Luna's single product excluded alcoholic offerings.

No restaurant-issued allergen matrix or complete ingredient source was found. Incomplete menu descriptions support only narrow named-ingredient positives and cannot validate frozen complete arrays, allergen negatives, or source authority for the catalog.
No restaurant-issued may-contain, shared-equipment, or other cross-contact disclosure was located. The raw-food warning is a foodborne-illness notice, not cross-contact evidence.
Three linked PDF surfaces returned retrieval errors, preventing independent confirmation of Luna's claims that all linked menus were fully enumerated.

summary: Terra independently verified Balos identity and the official aggregate menu, checked all six scout surfaces and the scout's sole product/presentation group, and reconciled all 108 frozen keys exactly once. Luna missed three current official wine-list products and therefore overstated the missing baseline count. Menu descriptions and partial PDF access do not provide a complete, restaurant-issued allergen source or any cross-contact conclusion.
